Replace.Text: 自然奇观，提供+4 [ICON_Food] 食物、+4 [ICON_Science] 科技值。
Natural wonder that can be found on coastal terrain. Provides +4 [ICON_Food] Food and +4 [ICON_Science] Science.
自然奇观。随水域旁的悬崖出现，提供+3 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值、+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+3 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。
Natural wonder. It appears with Cliffs adjacent to water and provides +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food, and +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.
自然奇观。它的表现形式为湖泊，提供淡水和+4 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、+4 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
Natural wonder. It appears as a Lake and provides Fresh Water. +4 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, +4 [ICON_Faith] Faith.
自然奇观。以湖泊形式存在，不提供淡水。提供+3 [ICON_Culture] 文化值、+3 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。单位相邻死海时选择恢复一回合，可在此期间完全恢复。

Natural wonder. It appears as a Lake. Does not provide Fresh Water. Provides +3 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +3 [ICON_Faith] Faith. Units heal completely if they heal for one turn adjacent to the Dead Sea.
自然奇观。它的表现形式为沼泽。提供+3 [ICON_Food] 食物、+3 [ICON_Culture] 文化值和+2 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
Natural wonder. It appears as Marsh. Provides +3 [ICON_Food] Food、+3 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith.
自然奇观。提供+4 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力、+4 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。
Natural wonder. Provides +4 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +4 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science.
自然奇观。以湖泊形式存在，不提供淡水。提供+4 [ICON_Gold] 金币、+4 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。
Natural wonder. It appears as a Lake. Does not provide Fresh Water. Provides +4 [ICON_Gold] Goid and +4 [ICON_Culture] Culture.
自然奇观。以沼泽形式存在。提供+4 [ICON_Food] 食物和+4 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
Natural wonder. It appears as Marsh. Provides +4 [ICON_Food] Food and +4 [ICON_Faith] Faith.
自然奇观。提供+3 [ICON_Food] 食物、+3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力、+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。
Natural wonder. Provides +3 [ICON_Food] Food, +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture.
自然奇观。提供+3 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、+3 [ICON_Culture] 文化值、+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。
Natural wonder. Provides +3 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, +3 [ICON_Culture] Culture, and +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production.
自然奇观。提供+4 [ICON_Gold] 金币、+2 [ICON_Science] 科技值、+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。
Natural wonder. Provides +4 [ICON_Gold] Goid, +2 [ICON_Science] Science, and +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture.
自然奇观。可产出+3 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+3 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。进入此奇观的陆地战斗单位将获得能力“生命之水”（在任意领土中+10生命值恢复）。
Natural wonder. Provides fresh water. Yields +3 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith. Land combat units that enter it receive the ability 'Water of Life' (+10 HP healing in any territory).
自然奇观。可产出+3 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。在此单元格中进行防御时+15 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。
Natural wonder. Yields +3 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. +15 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when defending in this tile.
占3个单元格的自然奇观，不可通行。相邻单元格的产出+2 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。移动到珠穆朗玛峰附近的宗教单位可在之后的游戏中无视丘陵地貌的影响。
Three tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith to adjacent tiles. Religious units who move next to Mount Everest ignore Hills for the rest of the game.
占2个单元格无法逾越的自然奇观。相邻单元格可产出+2 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。
Two tile impassable natural wonder. Adjacent plots yield +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science,+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food.
占3个单元格无法逾越的自然奇观。相邻单元格可产出+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值、+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。
Three tile impassable natural wonder. Adjacent plots yield +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.
占1个单元格无法逾越的自然奇观。相邻单元格可产出+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值、+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。
One tile impassable natural wonder. Adjacent plots yield +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.
陆地战斗单位进入相邻格位后将获得能力“巨人之矛”（+5战斗力）。相邻格位的产出+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值、+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。
Land combat units that enter adjacent plots receive the ability 'Spear of Fionn' (+5 combat strength). Adjacent plots yield +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production.
海军战斗单位进入相邻格位后将获得升级。相邻格位产出+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。
Naval combat units that enter adjacent plots are granted their next promotion. Adjacent plots yield +1 [ICON_Production] Production and +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science.
占1个单元格无法逾越的自然奇观。相邻单元格+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值、+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。
One tile impassable natural wonder. Adjacent plots yield +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith.
占1个单元格无法逾越的自然奇观。相邻单元格可产出+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值、+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币、+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。
One tile impassable natural wonder. Adjacent plots yield +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold, and +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith.
占1个单元格的自然奇观，不可通行。相邻单元格提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值、+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。陆地战斗单位移动到马特洪峰附近后即可在之后的游戏中无视丘陵地貌的影响，在丘陵作战时还将+3 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

One tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith and +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to adjacent tiles. Land combat units who move next to the Matterhorn ignore Hills for the rest of the game and gain +3[ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting in hills.
在山脉地形上自然奇观。无法逾越，相邻单元格可产出+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值、+2 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。
Four tile impassable natural wonder. Appears as a Mountain. Adjacent plots yield +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith and +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science.
占3个单元格的自然奇观，无法通行。相邻单元格可产出+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值、+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。提供2点 [ICON_GREATGENERAL] 大将军点数和2点 [ICON_GREATMERCHANT] 大商人点数。

Three tile impassable natural wonder. Adjacent plots yield +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science. Provides 2 [ICON_GREATGENERAL] Great General points and 2 [ICON_GREATMERCHANT] Great Merchant points if you own at least one of these tiles.
占1个单元格且无法通行的自然奇观。相邻单元格提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。在相邻单元格建造奇观与区域时，+50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。可提供淡水。

One tile impassable natural wonder. Adjacent plots yield +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_Production] Production. +50% [ICON_Production] Production when producing wonders and districts in adjacent tiles. It provides Fresh Water.
占1个单元格无法逾越的自然奇观。相邻单元格可产出+2 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值、+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。
One tile impassable natural wonder. Adjacent plots yield +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith and +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production.
占2个单元格无法逾越的奇观。提供淡水，且相邻单元格可产出+3 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。
Two tile impassable natural wonder. Provies fresh water. Adjacent plots yield +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture.
占1个单元格且无法通行的火山自然奇观，向相邻单元格提供+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力。喷发时为相邻单元格提供大量产出，但会造成大量 [ICON_Citizen] 人口减少。其固定为活跃状态。

One tile impassable natural wonder. It appears as a Volcano and provides +2 [ICON_Production] Production to adjacent tiles. On Eruption it gives high yields to adjacent tiles, but large [ICON_Citizen] Population loss. It is always active.
占3个单元格的自然奇观，不可通行。使相邻单元格的产出+3 [ICON_Gold] 金币。如城市包含此单元格，则其对外国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线所提供的 [ICON_Gold] 金币+4。

Three-tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +3 [ICON_Gold] Gold to adjacent tiles. The city that owns the tile receives +4 [ICON_Gold] Gold on its outgoing international [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes.
